pages.title: 01 // THE UI SHELL NIGHTMARE
pages.content:
Most modern web apps are bloated. You embed an interactive 3D tool into your main site; suddenly, the sub-component re-renders the navbar. Styles clash. CSS variables leak. The mobile viewport breaks, and the browser memory spikes to 2GB.

Cybernetic Brutalism strips away the fat. Obsidian #09090B, Electric Indigo #5322FF, 1px borders, JetBrains Mono precision. Form follows pure mechanical function.

pages.title: 02 // THE STRIPPING SHELL STRATEGY
pages.content:
How do you guarantee 100% security and zero style leakage? Enforce the Stripping Shell Strategy.

The CraftStudioConfigurator component never imports parent navigation UI. The generated Three.js code is injected into an in-memory iframe via srcdoc. No temporary files written to server disk, no cross-origin CORS vulnerabilities, and no CSS pollution in parent DOM.

<iframe
  srcDoc={htmlStream}
  sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"

  title="Live AST Preview"

pages.title: 03 // THE UNBREAKABLE SYSTEM & FAIL-FAST GATES
pages.content:
Before any code reaches production, it passes through four safety gates:
1. Zod Client Gate: SwissDesignConfigSchema validates AST structures.
2. Standard Alias Shield: Strict @/components/... mapping.
3. Dynamic Stream Protocol: Pure string piping to client memory.
4. Build Gate Verification: Zero-tolerance npx tsc --noEmit check.
